title: AS2 → AVM1 bytecode compiler
description: Compile AS2 AST (from parser in packages/core/src/as2/) to AVM1 bytecode in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts. Output: Uint8Array of action records (without EndAction). Cover: variable declarations (ActionDefineLocal2), assignments (ActionSetVariable), function calls (ActionCallFunction/ActionCallMethod), control flow (if/while/for via ActionIf/ActionJump), return, arithmetic/comparison operators, new expressions, member access (ActionGetMember/ActionSetMember), array/object literals. Export compileAS2(ast: Program): Uint8Array from as2/index.ts. See docs/12-actionscript.md.
